notes: Workbench-preprocessed TransportModels deck (drift-diffusion IdVgs node). Its Physics set (Fermi, OldSlotboom, DopingDep, e/hHighFieldsaturation(GradQuasiFermi), Enormal, SRH(DopingDep TempDependence)) is entirely within the supported list; the only blockers are the Thermode{} section and the System(...) shell command.

Thermode{} is inert here because no Temperature equation is solved; the plan nevertheless rejects it in stage 1 (section 4.6). Downgrading an inert Thermode{} to a warning is a recorded follow-up decision, not part of WP0.
System(...) executes a shell command in sdevice; vela device never runs shell commands from a deck (E109).
